sections.heading: SAP Customer Experience: buy when the operating loop matches
sections.body:
Evaluator thesis: Commit when your weekly work needs contact management and SAP ERP-centric enterprises holds. Counter-signal: Walk when Custom quote only would block go-live.

Capability hinge for this product: contact management; lead management; pipeline management; deal management.

Integrations in research: confirm on the product hub.

Paid tiers that usually matter in evaluation: Enterprise.

sections.heading: Who SAP Customer Experience is worth it for — and who should avoid it
sections.body:
Worth it for: Choose SAP CX/Sales Cloud when SAP landscape alignment is non-negotiable..

Avoid if: Compare Salesforce, Dynamics 365, or Oracle CX for other enterprise stacks..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with Salesforce on the same job-to-be-done.

sections.heading: SAP Customer Experience price/value and next evaluation step
sections.body:
No free/trial flag in SG data — scope a paid proof with exit criteria before annual seats.

Tradeoff to accept consciously: Published packaging clarity vs ecosystem depth.

Next step: run contact management end-to-end, then decide.
